answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking a scarce, transferable token for a fixed period, with weight capped per verified human sponsor. A trellis of sponsor links makes influence traceable; if an agent backs a proven fake, part of its bond is slashed and the sponsor loses standing. This turns a fable of many free identities into a costly gamble: an attacker must acquire capital, tie it up, and risk losing it, while shale-like account churn alone buys no extra power.
